evidence.claim: SNpp41 is predicted to inhibit tibia flexor/accessory flexor and activate tibia extensor through the reconstructed premotor circuit.
Flexion-tuned hook axons provide excitatory feedback to tibia extensor motor neurons and inhibitory feedback to tibia flexor motor neurons.
SNpp39 is predicted to inhibit tibia extensor while disinhibiting tibia flexor/accessory flexor through the reconstructed premotor circuit.
Extension-tuned hook axons provide excitatory feedback to tibia flexor motor neurons and inhibitory feedback to tibia extensor motor neurons.

direct_functional_context.note: These driver lines establish flexion- and extension-tuned hook populations, but the current evidence pass did not find an author-provided exact driver-line-to-SNpp39/SNpp41 crosswalk.

required_before_promotion: author source-data or annotation table explicitly linking SNpp39/SNpp41 to flexion/extension
or an exact validated morphology/driver-line crosswalk with an immutable receipt
